name: aangan
description: Aangan: the family group chat where everyone reads in their own way.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.dev:test: concurrently -k -n test-server,test-web -c magenta,cyan "AANGAN_ROOM=test TRANSLATE_MOCK=${TRANSLATE_MOCK:-1} npm run dev -w server" "AANGAN_API_PORT=3002 npm run dev -w web -- --port 5174 --strictPort"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
